body.compose:
# CR_TEST_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: explicit local PoC approval is required before deployment.
name: cr-demo-infra-eng-b164bab5
x-cr-test-approval-required: 'POST /api/deploy/{id}/up with {"test_approved": true}'
services:
  attacker:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-b164bab5-attacker
    networks:
    - external
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: alpine:3.22@sha256:49340b346798875b5592e5d420241f2f9cfba5f47e62ebb1446a1b34734e898f
    user: 65532:65532
    command:
    - sh
    - -c
    - sleep 2147483647
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
    depends_on:
      web:
        condition: service_healthy
  web:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-b164bab5-web
    networks:
    - external
    - scenario-internal
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /var/www/html:rw,nosuid,size=384m,uid=33,gid=33,mode=0755
    - /var/run/apache2:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=8m,uid=33,gid=33,mode=0755
    - /var/lock/apache2:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=8m,uid=33,gid=33,mode=0755
    - /var/log/apache2:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,uid=33,gid=33,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: wordpress:7.1.4-php8.3-apache@sha256:8b64037bb2a3bdc41bebccb165f20ad5e4c786b684ae4a2bd5981f98aa1eb107
    user: '33:33'
    cap_add:
    - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    environment:
      WORDPRESS_DB_HOST: db:3306
      WORDPRESS_DB_NAME: app
      WORDPRESS_DB_USER: app
      WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD: ${CR_DB_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -sS
      - -o
      - /dev/null
      - --max-time
      - '8'
      - --fail
      - http://127.0.0.1:80/wp-login.php
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
    mem_limit: 768m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
  db:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-b164bab5-db
    networks:
    - scenario-internal
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /var/lib/mysql:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=768m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700
    - /var/run/mysqld:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=8m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: mysql:8.0.46@sha256:7dcddc01f13bab2f15cde676d44d01f61fc9f99fe7785e86196dfc07d358ae2b
    user: 999:999
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${CR_DB_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${CR_DB_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: app
      MYSQL_USER: app
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - mysqladmin
      - ping
      - -h
      - 127.0.0.1
      - --protocol=tcp
      - --silent
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
    mem_limit: 1g
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
  cr-gateway:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-b164bab5-cr-gateway
    image: python@sha256:a0f57064cbdcd6285fa45f51237ab0b35ea8ebaed06a1f5973e89e19dfb86704
    command:
    - python
    - -c
    - "import asyncio,sys\nasync def pipe(r,w):\n try:\n  while True:\n   d=await\
      \ r.read(65536)\n   if not d: break\n   w.write(d); await w.drain()\n except\
      \ Exception: pass\n finally:\n  try: w.close()\n  except Exception: pass\nasync\
      \ def serve(lp,h,p):\n async def handle(r,w):\n  try: r2,w2=await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.open_connection(h,p),5)\n\
      \  except Exception:\n   w.close(); return\n  await asyncio.gather(pipe(r,w2),pipe(r2,w))\n\
      \ s=await asyncio.start_server(handle,'0.0.0.0',lp)\n await s.serve_forever()\n\
      async def main():\n rules=[a.split('=',1) for a in sys.argv[1:]]\n await asyncio.gather(*[serve(int(lp),t.rsplit(':',1)[0],int(t.rsplit(':',1)[1]))\
      \ for lp,t in rules])\nasyncio.run(main())\n"
    - 20000=web:80
    networks:
    - edge
    - external
    ports:
    - target: 20000
      published: ${CR_HOSTPORT_0:-42000}
      host_ip: ${CR_BIND_IP:-127.0.0.1}
      protocol: tcp
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    user: 65532:65532
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - python
      - -c
      - import socket; socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',20000),2).close()
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 6
    mem_limit: 128m
    cpus: 0.5
    pids_limit: 64
networks:
  external:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-b164bab5-external
    internal: true
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.bridge.gateway_mode_ipv4: isolated
  scenario-internal:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-b164bab5-scenario-internal
    internal: true
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.bridge.gateway_mode_ipv4: isolated
  edge:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-b164bab5-edge
    internal: false
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.bridge.enable_icc: 'false'
      com.docker.network.bridge.enable_ip_masquerade: 'false'

level_criteria.full_chain: 取 env_build、behavior_repro、每條宣告路徑及每個情境 IR 動作（every Scenario IR action）中的最低狀態。只有存在安全連線或服務證據時，動作才標為 PARTIAL；此驗證器不會執行攻擊動作。任何必要步驟為 NOT_TESTED 或 FAIL 時，整體不可判定為 PASS。
